configurePresets.name: qtprofiler-wasm
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile the standalone qtprofiler for Qt for WebAssembly. Builds only the Profiler plugin dependency closure plus the qtprofiler executable. Expects an activated emsdk (source emsdk_env.sh) and two environment variables: QT_WASM_ROOT pointing at a Qt for WebAssembly (multithread) installation, e.g. ~/Qt/6.11.1/wasm_multithread, and QT_HOST_PATH pointing at the matching host Qt, e.g. ~/Qt/6.11.1/macos.
